reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: Gate 1 skipped (pre-condition / missing guard type — the issue is the absence of a startup throw, not an uncalled function); Gate 2 skipped (no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json, and /oauth/userinfo is a public endpoint); Gate 3 passed (src/lib/oauth.ts backs in-scope OAuth 2.0 endpoints, not in out_of_scope). Spec deviation confirmed: line 11 of src/lib/oauth.ts uses `|| 'your-secret-key-change-in-production'` with no guard that aborts on the default, directly violating the property assertion. Attack path is concrete but conditioned on a deployment misconfiguration (JWT_SECRET env var not set): an attacker can trigger this by reading the publicly known default secret from the source repository, forging an HS256 JWT with arbitrary sub/scope claims, and calling GET /oauth/userinfo (or any verifyAccessToken-gated endpoint) to impersonate any club member. Severity maintained at Medium because exploitation requires a specific deployment error to be present.
